metadata.question: Did the sea surface temperatures in March 2022 at a location 100 km offshore east of Cairns, Australia, show temperature changes greater than 1°C compared to the overall average water temperatures from 2003 to 2014?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use NOAA OISST v2.1 daily global SST (NOAA/OISST/V2_1), which spans 1981–present. Filter to March 2022 for the event and 2003-01-01 to 2014-12-31 for the baseline. Location is a point 100 km east of Cairns (-16.9186, 145.7781), computed by converting 100 km to degrees longitude at that latitude; average over a 15 km buffer.
2. Masking strategy: SST products are already quality-controlled; no cloud masking needed.
3. Valid Zero vs Null: Check collection sizes; if 0, attempt a widened date fallback. After reduction, ensure pixel counts >0 (C2). If mean is null/NaN or out of plausible range (-5 to 45 C), return C3.
</thinking>

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfoAsync(obj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

function toFixedSafe(num, decimals) {
  if (num === null || num === undefined || !isFinite(num)) return null;
  return Number(num).toFixed(decimals);
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const cairnsLat = -16.9186;
    const cairnsLon = 145.7781;
    const km = 100;
    const earthKmPerDeg = 111.32;
    const lonDegOffset = km / (earthKmPerDeg * Math.cos(cairnsLat * Math.PI / 180.0));
    const ptLon = cairnsLon + lonDegOffset;
    const ptLat = cairnsLat;
    const point = ee.Geometry.Point([ptLon, ptLat]);
    const region = point.buffer(15000); // 15 km buffer

    const marchStart = ee.Date('2022-03-01');
    const marchEnd = ee.Date('2022-04-01');
    const baseStart = ee.Date('2003-01-01');
    const baseEnd = ee.Date('2015-01-01'); // inclusive of 2014

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const oisst = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/OISST/V2_1').select('sst');

    let colMar = oisst.filterDate(marchStart, marchEnd).filterBounds(point);
    let colBase = oisst.filterDate(baseStart, baseEnd).filterBounds(point);

    let marSize = await getInfoAsync(colMar.size());
    let baseSize = await getInfoAsync(colBase.size());

    // Fallback: widen date ranges slightly if needed
    if (marSize === 0) {
      const marchStartFB = marchStart.advance(-15, 'day');
      const marchEndFB = marchEnd.advance(15, 'day');
      colMar = oisst.filterDate(marchStartFB, marchEndFB).filterBounds(point);
      marSize = await getInfoAsync(colMar.size());
    }
    if (baseSize === 0) {
      const baseStartFB = baseStart.advance(-30, 'day');
      const baseEndFB = baseEnd.advance(30, 'day');
      colBase = oisst.filterDate(baseStartFB, baseEndFB).filterBounds(point);
      baseSize = await getInfoAsync(colBase.size());
    }

    console.log(`Point (100 km E of Cairns): ${ptLon.toFixed(4)}, ${ptLat.toFixed(4)} (buffer 15 km)`);
    console.log(`OISST March 2022 Images: ${marSize}`);
    console.log(`OISST Baseline (2003–2014) Images: ${baseSize}`);

    if (marSize === 0 || baseSize === 0) {
      console.log('Empty collection in one or both periods after fallback.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing (mean images)
    const imgMar = colMar.mean();
    const imgBase = colBase.mean();

    // 4. Calculation and Validation
    const meanMarDict = imgMar.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}),
      geometry: region,
      scale: 10000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const meanBaseDict = imgBase.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}),
      geometry: region,
      scale: 10000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });

    const marMean = await getInfoAsync(ee.Dictionary(meanMarDict).get('sst_mean'));
    const marCount = await getInfoAsync(ee.Dictionary(meanMarDict).get('sst_count'));
    const baseMean = await getInfoAsync(ee.Dictionary(meanBaseDict).get('sst_mean'));
    const baseCount = await getInfoAsync(ee.Dictionary(meanBaseDict).get('sst_count'));

    console.log(`March 2022 Pixels: ${marCount}`);
    console.log(`Baseline Pixels: ${baseCount}`);

    if (!marCount || !baseCount || marCount === 0 || baseCount === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after processing.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    if (marMean === null || baseMean === null || !isFinite(marMean) || !isFinite(baseMean)) {
      console.log('Invalid mean value (null/NaN).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Range sanity check (SST plausible range)
    if (marMean < -5 || marMean > 45 || baseMean < -5 || baseMean > 45) {
      console.log('Mean value out of plausible SST range.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const diff = marMean - baseMean;
    console.log(`March 2022 SST: ${toFixedSafe(marMean, 2)} °C`);
    console.log(`Baseline (2003–2014) SST: ${toFixedSafe(baseMean, 2)} °C`);
    console.log(`Difference: ${toFixedSafe(diff, 2)} °C`);

    // 5. Decision
    const exceeded = Math.abs(diff) > 1.0;
    console.log(exceeded ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('Error');
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
